scope: Actual Chrome extension and Web Audio playback, labelled provider/audio fixtures; no paid services
checks: Initial readiness uses one translated sentence and one TTS clip, not 80 cues
Playback overlaps bounded nearby translation/TTS; manual pause stops lookahead
Forward/backward/repeated seeks translate and synthesize the new playhead without walking the skipped tail
Seek replay uses cached audio; current translated sentence is not retransmitted for translation
Rapid seeks reanchor to the final requested region
All synthesis requests reuse one registered reference and omit the WAV payload
